title: India’s Top Bank Says Data Centers Aiding Capex Cycle
description: Ashwini Kumar Tewari, managing director at the State Bank of India says that corporate spending on new-age industries such as data centers is emerging as a key driver. Tewari speaks exclusively with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Adobe Forecast Misses Views, Renewing Fears About AI Impact
description: Adobe Inc. gave an outlook for sales that narrowly missed analysts’ estimates, adding fuel to concerns that artificial intelligence upstarts are hurting the software maker’s business.

title: Blackstone’s AirTrunk Seeks $1.6 Billion Loan for Singapore IPO
description: AirTrunk, a data center operator owned by Blackstone Inc., is in talks with banks to borrow about S$2 billion ($1.6 billion) to help finance the public listing of a real estate investment trust backed by its assets, according to people familiar with the matter.
